| Organism | Species clade reads | Detected |
|---|---|---|
| pseudomonas aeruginosa | 811 | yes |
| escherichia coli | 72 | yes |
| lactobacillus fermentum (reported as Limosilactobacillus fermentum) | 26 | yes |
| enterococcus faecalis | 6457 | yes |
| staphylococcus aureus | 54 | yes |
| salmonella enterica | 4 | no |
| bacillus subtilis | 2 | no |
| listeria monocytogenes | not in report | no |
| saccharomyces cerevisiae | not in report | no |
| cryptococcus neoformans | not in report | no |

I searched the report for each organism name and found no listeria, saccharomyces or cryptococcus lines at all, so I counted them as zero reads.
